newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa follows NY up, ends at highs.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa follows NY up, ends at highs.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa closed at the day's highs after taking a bullish lead from New York, traders said.
"There wasn't much origin cocoa around, which helped take away some of the upside resistance," one added.
Active March last traded at 886 stg, 12 stg higher.
March volume was 4,030 lots of a total 9,546.
New York cocoa futures bolstered by speculative shortcovering and arbitrage buying against the London market, trading sources said.
